manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U}{U} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters you control
description:
Csat Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
If you control at least 6 Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Stormsplitter tokens, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.
